identity.name: Code Red
identity.notes: The official site and Toast heading identify Code Red at 2440 18th Street NW. The official-linked Toast slug and secondary address line say 2240; this is treated as a vendor typo because the store heading, menu, phone, and official outbound link bind the same sole Code Red business.

sources.excerpt: The official Code Red site identifies the Adams Morgan business, gives 2440 18th Street NW, Washington, DC 20009, and links its current menus and Toast store.
The complete current Bill of Fare exposes six food sections: shareables, chef's choice, fresh picks, supper selections, sides, and desserts.
The official daily 5–7 PM happy-hour page lists nine small plates plus the recurring Tuesday oyster offer; alcohol-only offers were excluded.
The official cocktail page includes a distinct Prohibition-Approved zero-proof panel with mocktails, Heineken 0, and bottled water; alcohol panels were excluded.
The official current navigation advertises an extended three-course Summer Restaurant Week menu available throughout August 2026.
The visually reviewed official image lists four first courses, five main-course presentations, and two desserts for August 2026.
Despite the legacy URL slug, the current official page and navigation advertise National Oyster Week for August 3–11, 2026.
The visually reviewed official flyer confirms $1 oysters August 3–11, 2026; alcohol-only shooter and bourbon promotions were excluded.

The official-linked Toast store displays CODE RED 2440 in its heading and exposes complete Food and Non-Alcoholic catalogs. Its 2240 slug/address line is a vendor typo; liquor sections are out of POC scope. Item dialogs provide allergy-request modifiers and a request advisory, not a product allergen matrix.

Fresh official-domain, document, linked-vendor, and targeted searches found current menus and generic allergy-request controls but no restaurant-issued product-by-allergen matrix or cross-contact statement.

matrixSearch.notes: Official allergen information is accurately unavailable after all four required search classes. Positive fields below are limited to explicit restaurant-issued or restaurant-linked ingredient/name evidence; blank arrays never assert absence.

findings.summary: The exact Adams Morgan restaurant is Code Red at 2440 18th Street NW; the official-linked Toast 2240 slug/address line is a vendor typo, not a separable location.
The current POC union contains 91 food and nonalcoholic products across official dinner, happy hour, zero-proof, August seasonal, Oyster Week, and linked ordering surfaces.
All four required searches are complete. No official product-by-allergen matrix or direct cross-contact statement was found; generic Toast allergy request controls are not composition evidence.
Two alcohol-only shots and one homepage marketing tagline in the frozen baseline are out of current food/nonalcoholic product scope; repeated serving-size and renamed presentations are consolidated.

proposedChanges: Bind the canonical record to Code Red at 2440 18th Street NW while preserving a note about the official-linked Toast 2240 typo.
Replace the 48-row mixed/under-extracted baseline projection with the 91-product current union of complete food and nonalcoholic surfaces.
Remove the homepage slogan and alcohol-only shots from product scope; consolidate duplicate wings, oyster sizes, bruschetta, and tenderloin-skewer presentations.

Publish official allergen data as accurately unavailable except for conservative positive ingredient evidence; do not convert allergy-request modifiers or missing disclosures into absence or cross-contact claims.
